sources.name: historical_50k
sources.provenance: Public Wikidata historical figures with introduced duplicate errors, per Splink 4.0.16 metadata
sources.license: MIT repository distribution; original Wikidata source CC0

manifest.split_method: SHA-256 ranked whole truth entities; floor 60/20/20; no record crosses a split
manifest.name: febrl3

scope: training-only model/feature IDF; entity-disjoint validation graph
pair_context: unweighted gram cosine; rank=1; gap=0 for every training/scoring/verification pair
candidate_scope: k=6 including self, then self removed and orientations unioned; at most five outgoing nonself neighbours

rows.bootstrap_units: true entities; fixed-partition contributions; cross-entity FP split equally

budget.score: exact unweighted gram-set cosine after retrieval
budget.dropped_grams_semantics: discarded blocking keys/hash buckets; summed across union children
